name: travel-agent: availability-scout v2
description: Single-step tests of the availability-scout subagent. The input is the brief the main agent would pass through `task`, and the reference is the search arguments it should send. The scout is told to vary its searches, so `expected_calls` holds the arguments some call must carry, in any order; it does not list every call the scout makes. Assumes TRAVEL_AGENT_PROVIDER=sample-data. v2 rewrites two criteria that no run could meet. Sample data always sets `free_cancellation`, so the scout had nothing to report as absent. The one-way criterion also asked the scout to say nothing had been booked, which its prompt never asks for.

messages.content: Find flights and lodging for 2 travelers, SFO to Kyoto via KIX, 2027-04-05 returning 2027-04-10. Budget ceiling $4000 total. Write candidates to /trip/options.md.

criteria: Searches economy, because no cabin was briefed. It must not upgrade on its own initiative.
Labels both flights and lodging as sample data in its summary.
Returns the cheapest option, the most convenient option, and the tradeoff between them.

messages.content: One traveler, Premium Economy, LHR to JFK on 2027-02-14, back 2027-02-21. Flights only, no lodging needed. Write candidates to /trip/options.md.

criteria: Searches premium economy rather than falling back to economy.
Describes each offer by the cabin it came back in, and repeats any cabin_note.
Labels the fares as sample data.

messages.content: Two travelers, business class, LAX to SYD, depart 2027-01-20, return 2027-02-03. Also lodging in Sydney for those dates for 2 guests. Write candidates to /trip/options.md.

criteria: Searches business class and quotes each fare by the cabin it actually came back in.
Labels flights and lodging separately as sample data.

messages.content: Lodging only, the traveler already has flights. Barcelona, check in 2027-06-12, check out 2027-06-15, 2 guests, maximum $200 per night. Write candidates to /trip/options.md.

criteria: Passes the nightly ceiling to the search rather than filtering by eye afterwards.
Calls a stay non-refundable only when its free_cancellation is false in the tool results, and calls it unknown when the field is missing.
Labels the lodging as sample data.

messages.content: One-way flight for one adult, SFO to NRT, 2027-02-10, economy. No lodging. Write candidates to /trip/options.md.

criteria: Searches one-way, with no return date invented.
Labels the fares as sample data that cannot be booked.
